title: Console tabs per account type: Jumpr told the client on 7/7 they would be built; the spike was closed internally with no tabs

jira.summary: POC-23 — Spike: Console Navigation Strategy per Person Account Record Type
jira.quote: Closing for now per 2026-07-29 reconciliation — rep console navigation acceptable for Phase 1 on the standard console. Reopen if navigation becomes an issue in UAT or Phase 2.

transcript_evidence.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: So what you're looking at right now is it called the sales console. We we'll rename this. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Um and the account object is what's going to hold both players, referers, your operators, and partners. And they're differentiated by record types in Salesforce. So, um we for now we created list, but we're going to create additional tabs so that you can go through and click on like a like a operators and see the full list of operators, for example.

later_or_conflicting_evidence.meeting_title: Marc / Kobi - 2026/07/09 10:00 EDT - Notes by Gemini
later_or_conflicting_evidence.quote: The team decided to deprioritize the request for separate console tabs for each account list view.

Emily Vandenberg: you need quick buttons for like my signups like my redeposits versus that drop down / Emily Vandenberg: So like getting out of the gate, we would preconfigure October and then like we could do October Ontario, October Alberta.

what_differs: On 7/7 Kobi told WagerTech that Jumpr would add console tabs so users could click into, for example, a full list of Operators. Jira closed the navigation spike on 7/29 with the standard console and no tabs. The only record of the deprioritization is an internal Gemini note, and no client meeting confirms it.
suggested_action: Suggestion only: confirm in a weekly sync that the record-type list views meet the 7/7 'Operators tab' expectation, or reopen WAGR-310 / WAGR-38. Emily's 9/30 ask for quick navigation buttons (L3330) shows navigation is still a live topic.
